page_title: Professional photo & video enhancement powered by AI | Topaz Labs

sources.entry: 3. Topaz Labs - AI software for image and video enhancement.

summary.name: Topaz Labs
summary.one_liner: Topaz Labs sells AI-based software for enhancing photos and video, covering tasks such as denoising, sharpening, upscaling and face enhancement.
keywords: low resolution image to high resolution
use_cases: enhance and slow down video footage
summary.what_it_does: The page describes photo and video enhancement software powered by deep learning. Listed features include Unblur, Sharpen, Denoise, Relight Image, Standard and Creative Upscale, Photo Restoration, Face Enhancer, Background Remover and Colorizer. Video-related features include Precision Upscale, Frame Interpolation, Slow Motion, SDR to HDR and Stabilization. Cloud-based Wonder and Starlight model options are also mentioned. Product names on the page include Topaz Video, Topaz Photo, Topaz Gigapixel, Topaz for Mobile, Topaz for Web and Topaz Studio.
notable: Covers both photo and video enhancement under one brand
Cloud-based models (Wonder, Starlight) alongside local processing
Claims over 2 billion images processed and an Emmy award for its technology
caveats: Subscription plans with monthly credits that expire at month end and do not roll over
Commercial use free only for organizations under $1M USD annual revenue
Web export limits apply to web products; additional credits must be purchased
